_note: Characteristic values for Brettschichtholz, as Tabelle 47's for Vollholz: Anhang B derives them from the lamella tensile strength and E_m,mean of Tabelle 9, and they govern over footnote 4 of Tabelle 9 (5/6 of E_0,mean; GL24h: 9583 against 9600). Footnote 2 is the table's own mark 1) on GL20h, GL32c and GL32h. Every grade of Tabelle 9 has a row, and no other.
